To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the critical current density of YBaCuO-samples prepared by static pressing decreases with silver concentration, whereas in the samples prepared by dynamic pressing the opposite trend was observed.
the superconducting parameters and the degree of orthorhombicity of YBaCuO ceramics are significantly affected by the technological scheme used for preparation of powder composites with silver.

in the composites YBa/CuO-Ag prepared with static and hot pressing the superconducting parameters are practically insensitive to Ag content, while in the dynamically pressed samples the orthorhombicity of the YBa/Cu/O phase and critical temperature and critical current density of the composite decrease appreciably already at low Ag contents.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the investigation of the influence of a technological scheme of pressing on the superconducting properties of YBaCuO ceramics with Ag additions.
a study of effect of a technological process on superconducting properties of YBaCuO ceramics.
the influence of the technological scheme of pressing on the superconducting parameters and structural characteristics of YBaCuO ceramics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dynamic pressing of YBCO powders is not recommended for fabrication of composites YBCO-Ag.
the structure and superconduting parameters of composites are strongly dependent on a pressing scheme and the best results are achieved by hot pressing of powder mixtues.
dynamic pressing is not suitable for the fabrication of composites with high critical temperature and transport critical current densities.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best results were obtained for composites with 10 vol.% Ag, prepared by static pressing, and for 5 vol.% Ag, hot pressed, while the worst results were achieved for dynamically pressed samples.

in the composites of the YBa/sub 2/Cu/sub 3/O/sub 7-δ/ with silver prepared by static or hot pressing, the silver content of up to 30 vol.% is favourable for the superconducting properties of the YBa/sup 2/Cu/sup 3/O/sub x/, while in the dynamically pressed samples, the silver content should be less than 10 vol.%.
the superconducting properties of the composites YBa/sub 2/Cu/sub 3/O/sub 6.5/-Ag are very sensitive to the pressing technique used.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the structure of YBa/sub 2/Cu/sub 3/O/sub 7-/spl delta/-Ag composite ceramics depends on a method of pressing.
the dynamic compaction of the YBa/sub 2/Cu/sub 3/O/sub 6+x/-Ag composites results in the significant deterioration of their structure and superconductivity parameters.

the structure of the YBCO-Ag composites prepared by dynamic compaction is worse than that of the composites prepared by static and hot pressing and the critical current density and the critical temperature of the former are lower.
